mcqs.question: What decision was taken by the Andhra Pradesh Health Department regarding Jan Aushadhi stores?
options: To set up Jan Aushadhi stores only in 16 Government General Hospitals
To set up Jan Aushadhi stores in all Government General Hospitals
To set up a Jan Aushadhi store only at Nandyal Government General Hospital
To first set up Jan Aushadhi stores in all District and Area Hospitals
mcqs.explanation: The decision was to set up Jan Aushadhi stores in all Government General Hospitals in Andhra Pradesh. The proposal for District and Area Hospitals was only at the feasibility-study stage, while the review covered 16 GGHs and noted that Nandyal GGH had no private medical store.
